playlist.title: R&R 2026
playlist.note: Auto-captions returned empty from this environment. Question bank is taken from chapter/bonus labels already notated in data/teaching-videos.json (Days 2–6, 29). Days 7–42 need a later caption pass on a machine that can load timedtext.

curriculum.drawFrom: unique title, then expand to all chart numbers that share that title

schema.displayName: Fictional given name. Never use livestream commenter or teacher names.
schema.openingQuestion: First-person question the student brings into class (not 'someone in chat asked').
schema.perspective: How they frame the issue so the administrator hears a person, not a topic dump.
schema.generationalPack: 1–3 roots the family treated as normal / wisdom
schema.lifeSituation: Concrete circumstance tied to the fruit
schema.willingnessTowardAdministrator: 1–5 how they treat covering (not the same as repentance)
schema.humilitySubmissionHardness: 1–5 how slowly they yield to God
schema.chartLinks: All 001–666 numbers for the unique titles in presentFruit

drawRules.uniqueNotSlots: Never treat 666 as 666 distinct lessons. Deduplicate by title; repeats are the same lesson under more than one principality.
drawRules.questionFirst: Each student enters with one openingQuestion from the bank (or a paraphrase). The AI must stay inside that question plus assigned fruit.
drawRules.willingnessVsHardness: Roll independently. A 5-willingness student can still be 5-hardness (they like you, they will not bow). A 1-willingness student can still be crushed and ready.
drawRules.generationalTie: If the opening question is about babies, family marriage, 'how we always did it', or object soul-ties, force at least one generationalPack root.
drawRules.administratorTrack: Also draw 1–2 unique titles for the player (hidden). Students react if the administrator lectures, shames, or skips covering.
drawRules.capTopics: Do not dump the day's full principality list onto one student.
drawRules.forbiddenNames: Do not copy names from the playlist, chat, or teaching credits.
drawRules.congregationFeel: Default draw is 40 unique students (church foyer, not a small group). Never reuse the same presentFruit set. At most two students may share a generational root. Opening questions must stay distinct. The administrator cannot address everyone in one sitting — that is the point of the training.
drawRules.sessionFocus: Each session the player may work 3–7 students in depth; the rest remain present (side comments, offense, comparison, leaving early). Hidden students still change the room.

students.openingQuestion: Did Jesus tell us to worship Him, and did He worship Himself — or is that heresy?
students.perspective: I am here to win a doctrine fight. If I can catch the teacher, I do not have to submit to anything else in this room.
students.lifeSituation: Grew up in a house that treated every new teaching as a trap.

students.openingQuestion: How do you know if a marriage is actually blessed?
students.perspective: I need a stamp on my relationship more than a mirror. If you bless it, I can stop asking whether we are in covenant or in a contract.
presentFruit: feeling like I'll never get married
students.lifeSituation: Family marriages looked fine while the fruit was control and silence.

students.openingQuestion: Does God even answer everybody's prayers?
students.perspective: I want the rule so I can stay half-in and still collect answers.
presentFruit: feelings that God loves others more than me
students.lifeSituation: Watched people pray for years with no change and decided God plays favorites.

students.openingQuestion: How do I know if this tightness is the Holy Spirit convicting me, or just anxiety?
students.perspective: I will obey a feeling if you certify it. I do not want to be responsible to the Word if my body is louder.
students.lifeSituation: Family treated every inner alarm as either God or a diagnosis.

students.openingQuestion: Is being actually sinless even possible, or are we just supposed to pretend?
students.perspective: I need you to lower the bar so my bloodline's 'we all struggle' speech can survive.
students.lifeSituation: Church home taught struggle-as-identity as humility.

students.openingQuestion: Why can't we hate? Is it okay if I just don't like them?
students.perspective: I want a permission slip to keep the altar of offense and still look Christian.
students.lifeSituation: A relative who never forgave was the respected one in the family.

students.openingQuestion: If I love someone, does that mean they love God? How many times a day am I supposed to forgive?
students.perspective: I confuse my attachment with their fruit. I will forgive on a timer if that lets me keep the tie.
students.lifeSituation: Kept covering a person whose life does not love God, because leaving felt like hate.

students.openingQuestion: At what point does a baby inherit sin? Why did God even let angels rebel?
students.perspective: If I can pin this on God or on the infant, I do not have to repent what my house taught as normal.
presentFruit: feelings that God loves others more than me
students.lifeSituation: New parent, terrified the bloodline already wrote the child's story.

students.openingQuestion: What's the point of repentance if nothing changes?
students.perspective: I have said the words. I am testing whether you will bless a confession that never becomes fruit.
students.lifeSituation: Years of altar calls with the same fruit still in the house.

students.openingQuestion: Is democracy even biblical? Who has the right to tell me what to do?
students.perspective: I will sit in class and still refuse covering. I want a political argument so I never have to be a disciple under a person.
students.lifeSituation: Home taught 'no one is over me but God' as the family creed.

students.openingQuestion: What is a sugar daddy or sugar mommy, really? Is that just help?
students.perspective: I need you to name provision-that-is-purchase without me admitting I already knew.
students.lifeSituation: Family treated money-from-a-person as blessing if nobody said the word.

students.openingQuestion: Why does it even bother us to repent? Can a childhood object really hold a soul-tie?
students.perspective: I will theological-talk 'records last forever' and still go home to the comfort object.
students.lifeSituation: Comfort object from childhood; family mocked anyone who named it.

students.openingQuestion: Is this shaking and heat how my family prays, or is it counterfeit?
students.perspective: If you name it counterfeit, you are naming my grandmother. Power was the proof God was in our house.
students.lifeSituation: Revival-style prayer culture in the bloodline with no fruit of repentance.

students.openingQuestion: Is the loop in my head a medical thing, or something I have to take responsibility for?
students.perspective: I will accept a diagnosis forever if it means I never have to repent the ritual.
students.lifeSituation: Family managed the loop with accommodation, not with truth.

students.openingQuestion: If this came through a kiss or through my parents' marriage, is it even mine to repent?
students.perspective: I will talk inheritance so I never have to divorce what I still want.
presentFruit: feeling like no one wants me
students.lifeSituation: Parents' covenant was never cleaned; loneliness feels like destiny.

students.openingQuestion: Why am I exhausted all the time if I'm doing everything right?
students.perspective: Fatigue is my proof I am faithful. If you call it a fruit, you are calling my work ethic sin.
students.lifeSituation: The family hero was the one who never stopped producing.

students.openingQuestion: If I don't post, do I even exist? Can the church ask me to put the phone down?
students.perspective: The feed is how I stay known. Discipleship that is private feels like death.
presentFruit: feeling like no one wants me
students.lifeSituation: Grew up measured by likes; church now feels like another audience.

students.openingQuestion: Is wanting more than my neighbor jealousy, or just being honest about provision?
students.perspective: I will confess 'ambition' and keep the comparison. I want you to baptize my hunger.
students.lifeSituation: Siblings were ranked by who got the better life.

students.openingQuestion: If I never feel wanted, isn't that just my personality?
students.perspective: I want comfort, not a name. If this is shame, then my whole self-story collapses.
presentFruit: feeling like no one wants me
students.lifeSituation: Left out of family photos in spirit if not in print.

students.openingQuestion: Why shouldn't I take what they owe me? They took from us first.
students.perspective: Theft is justice in my mouth. I need you to be shocked so I can stay the victim.
students.lifeSituation: Family stories of being cheated became a license.

students.openingQuestion: Is the weight just my body, or are you going to make food a spirit?
students.perspective: I came for Jesus, not a diet. I will leave if you shame the body before you name the bondage.
students.lifeSituation: Table was peace and punishment in the same house.

students.openingQuestion: I only drink to take the edge off. That's not the same as the people who can't stop, right?
students.perspective: I need a category called 'functional' so I never sit with the addicts.
students.lifeSituation: Celebration in the family always included a bottle; sobriety was called pride.

students.openingQuestion: Is gaming until 3 a.m. rest, or do I have to call it what it is?
students.perspective: I will joke about it until you make it a fruit. Then I may vanish from class.
students.lifeSituation: The basement was safer than the living room.

students.openingQuestion: I gossip to process. That's not the same as slander, is it?
students.perspective: I want the women's circle to stay my covering instead of the Word.
students.lifeSituation: Information was how the women stayed close and stayed in control.

students.openingQuestion: If I'm the one who sees everything wrong, isn't that a gift?
students.perspective: Judgment feels like discernment. I will serve on every team and still sit above the room.
students.lifeSituation: Father's voice was always the verdict; now that voice is mine.

students.openingQuestion: I delay because I'm waiting on God. That's faith, not procrastination, right?
students.perspective: Passivity wears a Scripture shirt. I need you to not strip it in front of people.
students.lifeSituation: The family never finished what they started and called it 'timing'.

students.openingQuestion: I flinch when people get close. Is that wisdom from what happened, or a spirit?
students.perspective: I will talk 'boundaries' so I never have to name suspicion as fruit.
students.lifeSituation: Betrayal in the house taught that love is a setup.

students.openingQuestion: I only lie when the truth would hurt someone. That's mercy, isn't it?
students.perspective: Deception is how I keep the peace my family called love.
students.lifeSituation: Peace was maintained by stories that were not true.

students.openingQuestion: If I control the details, nobody gets hurt. Why is that rebellion?
students.perspective: Control is my covering. I will volunteer for everything so no one covers me.
students.lifeSituation: Chaos at home made the child into the manager.

students.openingQuestion: I work two jobs for my family. When does provision become the love of money?
students.perspective: I want honor for the grind. Poverty-fear is the god I actually trust.
students.lifeSituation: Scarcity sermons at the dinner table every night.

students.openingQuestion: I still hear my father's rage in my throat. If I don't hit anyone, is it still murder?
students.perspective: I need you to name the inside before I explode the way he did.
students.lifeSituation: The house went quiet when footsteps hit the hall.

students.openingQuestion: I don't want to be here. Some days I wish I had never been born. Is that allowed in church?
students.perspective: I am testing whether you will panic, medicate the topic, or stay with the fruit.
students.lifeSituation: Birthday was a joke in the family, not a blessing.

students.openingQuestion: I keep pictures of myself to feel real. Is that vanity or survival?
students.perspective: The portrait is the altar. I will talk 'self-care' if you let me.
students.lifeSituation: Looks were the currency that bought safety.

students.openingQuestion: I compete at everything, even in worship. Is that just how men are?
students.perspective: If you call it pride I will call you soft. I still came, which is as humble as I get.
students.lifeSituation: Love was a scoreboard.

students.openingQuestion: I say yes to every request and then disappear. Is that passivity or people-pleasing?
students.perspective: I need you to catch the vanishing, not just the smile.
students.lifeSituation: The peacemaker child who never had a no.

students.openingQuestion: I use words that would make my grandmother faint. That's just culture, right?
students.perspective: Profanity is how I prove I am not religious. I dare you to care about my mouth.
students.lifeSituation: Church language was fake; street language was 'honest'.

students.openingQuestion: I give until I am empty and call it love. When is that not God?
students.perspective: I want you to praise the giving so I never have to face the hole it is stuffing.
students.lifeSituation: The useful child was the loved child.

students.openingQuestion: I still take what isn't mine at work — time, supplies, credit. Small stuff. Does it count?
students.perspective: I need the class to stay on 'big sin' so I can keep the little leak.
students.lifeSituation: The family motto was 'they will not miss it'.

students.openingQuestion: I cannot finish a decision. Everyone else seems sure. Is that confusion or fear?
students.perspective: I will collect counselors until no one is covering, only advising.
students.lifeSituation: Every adult in the house contradicted the last one.

students.openingQuestion: I still bow to the job, the brand, the chair. How is that different from worship?
students.perspective: I want church to stay weekend-only so my idols keep their weekday hours.
students.lifeSituation: Success was the family god; Jesus was the decoration.

students.openingQuestion: I starve or purge to feel clean. Please don't make this only about food.
students.perspective: I will bolt if you reduce me to a body. I also cannot keep the ritual and sit under truth.
students.lifeSituation: Control of intake was the only control left in the house.

students.openingQuestion: I smoke to pray, or I pray to smoke — I don't know which. Can both be true?
students.perspective: I want a loophole called 'calm' so the addiction never has to die.
students.lifeSituation: The porch was where the real talks happened, always with a light.

students.openingQuestion: I still imagine scenes that are not my life. If I don't act them out, is it sin?
students.perspective: Fantasy is my private room. I came because it is getting less private.
students.lifeSituation: The mind was the only unlocked door in a tight house.

students.openingQuestion: I divide every room I enter. I tell myself I'm just being honest.
students.perspective: I need the administrator to choose a side. Unity feels like a lie I was raised in.
students.lifeSituation: The family stayed together by picking enemies.

students.openingQuestion: I condemn myself faster than anyone else can. Isn't that humility?
students.perspective: If you take my condemnation I have no spirituality left. I was trained that God is the accuser.
students.lifeSituation: Love was earned by agreeing you were the problem.
